episode_title: JuiceCon 2026 - What to expect at the juicing event of the year!
question: What is Juice Con and why was it created?
transcript_excerpt: Juice Con is the only conference in the entire world for juicing professionals where people that run juice bars, juice trucks, grocery stores that sell juice, restaurants, or wholesale juice businesses can come together and share information to help each other grow. It was started because every single juice bar that opened had the same struggles, and the founder started a blog in 2014 to help people save themselves from these problems before going through them themselves.

episode_title: JuiceCon 2026 - What to expect at the juicing event of the year!
question: When is Juice Con 2026 happening and what are the ticket prices?
transcript_excerpt: Juice Con 2026 is happening on Thursday and Friday, November 5th and 6th. Tickets are currently on sale for $4.99 but will increase to $6.99 on August 1st, saving $200 for early buyers. The event is expected to sell out with a capacity of 200 people.

episode_title: JuiceCon 2026 - What to expect at the juicing event of the year!
question: What is the format of Juice Con and how are sessions structured?
transcript_excerpt: Juice Con is formatted like TED Talks for Juice where knowledgeable speakers from all over the world give 15 to 20-minute presentations followed by panel discussions with other juice business owners. The audience can ask questions directly, chat with speakers after presentations, and there are vendor booths with workshops in a side room. There is also a live functioning juice bar at the event.

episode_title: JuiceCon 2026 - What to expect at the juicing event of the year!
question: Where is Juice Con 2026 being held and what are the venue facilities?
transcript_excerpt: Juice Con is being held at the Riverbend Center in West Lake, Austin, Texas, which is 20 to 25 minutes outside downtown Austin. The venue features a main room seating a couple hundred people, a smaller room with round tables for 50 people where lunch will be served, a cafe area that will be converted into a juice bar, vendor hallway space, and an outdoor area with a water fountain. The building was expanded and completed around 2014.

episode_title: JuiceCon 2026 - What to expect at the juicing event of the year!
question: What notable speakers are confirmed for Juice Con 2026?
transcript_excerpt: Confirmed speakers include Eric Ethans, co-founder of Suja Life whose company IPO'd for $700 million earlier this year; Chris Good, founder of Ruby Jean's Juicery who runs a foundation in Kansas City; Caitlin Slifer, one of the best juice bar operators with over 10 years in the game; Nori from Japan who runs Sunshine Juice in Tokyo and travels in a van powered by vegetable oil and solar electricity; Francesca Costa, owner of Cranky Carrot Juice Co. in Houston who is a nutritionist and certified personal trainer; and Kui Chang, who won the World Juicing Championship in 2019.

episode_title: JuiceCon 2026 - What to expect at the juicing event of the year!
question: What is the World Juicing Championship at Juice Con and how does it work?
transcript_excerpt: The World Juicing Championship takes place at the end of the second day of Juice Con and focuses on green juice. Participants submit their best green juice recipe to Ari, ingredients are provided on site, and participants make the juice with Ari in the morning. The audience tastes all juices and votes, while a panel of expert judges including Kwai Chang (who won the first World Juicing Championship) and Ari select the winner who receives the supreme title of world best green juice.
